system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Five failed interactive logons for leo.martins occurred on WS-LMARTINS-01 from 13:30:32 to 13:30:56 UTC. They share the same winlogon.exe process and report an incorrect-password substatus.

Explorer registry telemetry records UserAssist entries for paths that decode from ROT13 to Microsoft Word and Firefox; this is consistent with ordinary interactive use, but does not establish who initiated it.

At 13:53, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a successful type 3 Kerberos logon for leo.martins with source address 10.40.10.23. The record alone does not establish whether this was expected or which service accepted the logon.
At 13:57, leo.martins used Chrome to connect to the organization's proxy, and the proxy recorded a successful CONNECT tunnel to www.bing.com:443.

Several applications, including Cisco AnyConnect and Dropbox, terminated around 14:07, followed shortly by a type 2 logoff for leo.martins. The close timing is compatible with session teardown and does not by itself establish malicious termination.
Explorer telemetry records a change to the Internet Settings ProxyEnable value to 0 at 14:16. The record does not explain why the setting changed or whether it was authorized.

The evidence shows termination events for Dropbox and Cisco AnyConnect, applications that conflict with the supplied inventory context (Dropbox is not an approved file-sharing service and no VPN is available). These termination events do not establish that either application was installed, used for data transfer, or involved in malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records are a partial set; gaps in event IDs do not establish that no other activity occurred.
The records do not include process-creation details, command lines, parent processes, or a complete authentication audit trail.
The proxy and registry records do not establish the user's intent or whether the observed changes were authorized.
The source address in the WS-NBLAKE-01 logon record is not mapped to a device in the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: Whether the failed logons were routine password mistypes or an attempt by another person.
Whether the successful type 3 logon on WS-NBLAKE-01 was legitimate, what service it targeted, or whether it was related to the failed logons.
Whether Dropbox or AnyConnect were actively used, and whether any data was transferred through them.
Who changed the proxy setting, why it was changed, or whether the change was authorized.
Whether the session logoff and application terminations were user-initiated or caused by another process.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller authentication events for leo.martins and the relevant source address during the review window, including successful and failed logons.
Asset or network records mapping 10.40.10.23 and clarification of the type 3 logon target service on WS-NBLAKE-01.
Process-creation and endpoint detection telemetry around 14:07, including parent processes, command lines, and any shutdown or logoff initiator.
Software inventory and network telemetry for Dropbox and AnyConnect on WS-LMARTINS-01, including any file-transfer or external connection records.
Policy-management or endpoint logs identifying the actor and reason for the ProxyEnable change.
Confirmation from leo.martins or IT about the failed logons, session logoff, and proxy change.
